== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Squad Leader (Japanese)|Rebel Squad Leader]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/164793245/QWoZAGXBSE6YO3igGfYJ3A.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 164793245.

Crop rectangle <code>(262, 1118, 2331, 4004)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>3cd6ddd8281c12307ab29e857cbda18db97a8b6c197641fa1ddaa33cd6e316d1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
